Name: Destabilize
Description: Actions designed to undermine the internal stability, order, or legitimacy of a state or organization.

Name: Influence
Description: Actions aimed at altering the opinions, attitudes, or decisions of a target audience to align with the actor's goals.

Name: Control
Description: Actions intended to exert direct authority or dominance over a target's resources, policy, or decision-making process.

Name: Divide
Description: Actions designed to create, amplify, or exploit internal fissures within a society, organization, or alliance.

Name: Deceive
Description: Actions intended to provide false information or create false perceptions to mislead a target for strategic advantage.

Name: Delay
Description: Actions aimed at slowing down processes, decisions, or the development of target capabilities.

Name: Intimidate
Description: Actions used to coerce a target through fear, threats, or the credible threat of violence/harm.

Name: Steal
Description: Actions intended to illicitly obtain information, intellectual property, assets, or resources.

Name: Destroy
Description: Actions aimed at permanently disabling, damaging, or removing a target's physical or digital capabilities.

Name: Exploit
Description: Actions aimed at utilizing a target's existing weaknesses or vulnerabilities for strategic, political, or economic gain.

Name: Exhaust
Description: Actions designed to wear down a target's resources, patience, or operational endurance over time.

Name: Isolate
Description: Actions aimed at severing a target's ties, alliances, or communications to weaken its position or influence.
